subject: MAP: BrightBank security checkpoints and DPA redline timeline
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightBank Legal <legal@brightbank.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MAP ask — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team has a short list of vendor gating items before we can move to procurement: SOC 2 report, completed SIG/CAIQ answers, a DPA that reflects 7-year archival carveouts, and clarity on default data retention for embeddings and logs.

Can you send a mutual action plan with ownership, target dates (we're hoping to close legal by end of August), and the artifacts you'll provide (e.g., SOC 2 Type II report, CAIQ export, sample DPA with highlighted clauses)? If you have a template timeline, please include that — Legal wants to see specific handoff dates.

Samir
Account Exec — BrightBank
samir.patel@brightbank.com

--

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightbank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP ask — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a draft MAP workbook that breaks down artifacts, owners, and a proposed three-week timeline to get to an initial legal review. High level below and details are in the attached "brightbank_map_v1.xlsx":

- Week 1 (7/20–7/24): Evidence intake — we will provide SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), SIG/CAIQ export, and our DPA baseline. Owner: Kimberly.
- Week 2 (7/27–7/31): Legal redline cycle — BrightBank Legal reviews DPA redline, we consolidate comments. Owner: BrightBank Legal / Neha.
- Week 3 (8/3–8/7): Finalize DPA, confirm retention window, and sign (DocuSign). Target: Legal signoff by 8/7; procurement to follow.

Key notes:
- SOC 2: We can share our most recent Type II report under NDA within 24 hours of request.
- SIG/CAIQ: We'll export our CAIQ and populate any schedule-of-responses required.
- Data retention: Default embeddings cache is 30 days; logs retained for 90 days by default. For BrightBank we can propose a 90-day embeddings retention with a 7-year archival option specified in DPA if needed for regulatory reasons — we'll flag the sections for negotiation.

I've cc'd Jordan and Kimberly to coordinate evidence collection and the DPA baseline. Next step: Kimberly will upload the MAP workbook to the shared Drive and we will wait for any initial DPA redlines from your legal team.

Thanks — talk soon.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0142

From: BrightBank Legal <legal@brightbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightbank.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP ask — DPA redlines attached

Neha — attached is our first pass DPA redline. High level asks:

1) Retention: We prefer a contract commitment that customer data (including embeddings) can be archived for regulatory holds up to 7 years; please add specific export/escrow language.
2) Subprocessor list and notification window (30 days).
3) Audit evidence: SOC 2 Type II report must include scope details that cover inference runtime and key management; if any components are out of scope state them.

Please confirm who will be the technical contact for the CAIQ follow-up Q&A and provide the SOC 2 redacted report under NDA.

Regards,
Alice Chen
BrightBank — Legal Counsel
legal@brightbank.com

--
Attachment: DPA_redline_v2.pdf (PDF with redline annotations)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: evidence plan + SIG owner + DocuSign prep

Neha / Jordan — quick internal note on ownership and deliverables so we can respond to BrightBank cleanly: 

- SOC 2 report: I will prepare a redacted Type II and upload to the MAP Drive folder by 7/20 17:00 PT. Access will be gated; add Alice (legal@brightbank.com) as view-only.
- SIG/CAIQ: Jordan to coordinate; he’ll act as the technical lead for any follow-up Q&A. Aim to provide a populated CAIQ CSV by 7/22 EOD.
- DPA redline: I reviewed the BrightBank edits. We can accept the 30-day subprocessor notice but need to propose a scoped archival clause rather than a universal 7-year active retention. I'll prepare a counter-proposal and a DocuSign-ready DPA (version v3) by 7/23.
- Evidence tracker: I updated the MAP workbook with owners and status (column E).

Risks / asks: If BrightBank insists on a 7-year active retention for embeddings (rather than archival/escrow), that will require a product exceptions request and possible dedicated private deployment (impacts pricing). Flagging this for commercial.

Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Security — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

--

Date: 2026-07-23T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP and next steps: DPA counter + evidence delivery schedule

Hi Samir / Alice — circling back with the finalized MAP timeline and our next steps so Legal and Procurement have a single source of truth. Summary below; detailed workbook attached and live in the Drive.

What we will deliver and dates (owner):
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted) — Kimberly — uploaded by 2026-07-20 (Drive link provided).
- Populated SIG/CAIQ CSV — Jordan — 2026-07-22 EOD.
- DPA counter (v3) with scoped archival language and export/escrow options — Kimberly/Neha — 2026-07-23. DocuSign envelope prepared for final once redlines agree.

Ask from BrightBank Legal: Please confirm whether you can accept an archival/escrow approach (we provide secure export and 7-year archival access upon request) versus forcing 7-year active retention in a hosted service. If you need active 7-year retention for embeddings, we will need to discuss a private deployment/price delta.

DocuSign / legal links: 
- DPA (v3) draft: https://docusign.com/Envelope/ABC123
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/deal/BB-2026-0421

Next milestone: Aim to have DPA terms aligned by 2026-08-07 so procurement can start the PO process the week of 8/10. If Legal can return a second redline by 2026-07-28 we can stay on track.

Thanks — Kim / Jordan, please confirm when you’ve uploaded the CAIQ and updated the workbook. Samir / Alice, let me know if you want a short call this week (30 min) to walk through the archive vs active-retention tradeoffs.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
